name: Richard Wells
story: Richard Wells contributed to the 2024 Marine Geospatial Information Working Group discussion as a GEOINT New Zealand maritime team lead. The minutes record an ArcGIS Maritime presentation with Eagle Technology’s John Plunkett. Earlier project-held NZEUG records list Wells in the 2008 committee and the 2010 AGM, documenting participation in the professional community as well as defence mapping.

Steve Richards and Greg Bennett had left the committee at the December 2008 AGM, and the new committee was listed as Byron Cochrane, Glenn Russell, Igor Albornett, John Thyne, Junior Lee-Chee, Laura Nicol, Meghan Williams, Peter Fraser, Rachel Summers, Richard Wells and Tony Standen.
